research_question: does a model trained on dmr discriminate on cali
null_hypothesis: chance (AUROC 0.5) on the target; a collapse to chance is evidence that the source model learned cohort-specific signal, and is as much a result as a successful transfer
normalisation_note: under 'fixed' the source mean and sd are applied to the target, so a failure may be a camera calibration difference rather than a pathology one; run both modes before concluding
reference: predictions_source_internal.csv holds the same models scored on their own held-out source patients; the drop between the two is the quantity of interest, not the transfer AUROC alone
threshold_note: the decision threshold is chosen on source validation patients, so balanced accuracy on the target also carries any calibration shift; AUROC does not
